messages:
maria: noticed a weird spike in streaming reconnects + duplicate token counts around 09:12
josh: yup, saw that in the telemetry. starts ~09:11:22 and aligns with a proxy deploy in canary
olivia: the billing dashboard shows duplicate session charges for some tenants :grimacing:
alan: initial hunch: TLS renegotiation at the proxy causing midstream pause -> client gives up and reconnects, server treats reconnect as new session (billing)
katie: that canary was proxy v1.4.2 rolling a change to TLS session handling (rekey interval lowered)
maria: grabbing logs now, this looks like a rehandshake loop. snippet:
```
proxy[canary]: WARN tls: renegotiation detected; new session id a1b2c3
proxy[canary]: INFO upstream: downstream idle, pausing stream
sse-handler: ERROR client_disconnected code=1006 reason="read ECONNRESET"
router: route fallback -> us-east-3 (capacity).
```
josh: interesting — clients see 1006 (abrupt close) then immediately reconnect; because session-ids change we lose prefix KV cache and router treats new conn as fresh -> double charge
olivia: console shows two requests within 800ms for same token id, both billed. our idempotency key is per-connection, not per-token.
alan: two orthogonal problems: 1) proxy rekey triggers midstream close; 2) billing/idempotency keyed weakly to connection
katie: quick mitigation: revert TLS rekey change in canary and patch proxy to allow graceful in-flight sessions during rekey window
maria: can we add a tracing tag on TLS rekey events so console/telemetry can join the dots? right now the dashboard sampling drops the rekey events and we only see the reconnects
josh: i'll add a short-lived span "tls.rekey" at proxy layer with session_id in trace; that should tie to the existing sse.trace_id
olivia: on billing side we can dedupe within 2s windows by token id — relatively safe and would hide duplicates until upstream fix
alan: also add metric: streaming.session_rekey_count and streaming.session_resume_success to console so SLOs reflect rekey surface area
katie: rolling the revert now to canary patch group, will watch for reconnect counts
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-service v1.4.2 -> v1.4.1 canary (initiated by katie)
maria: after revert, reconnects dropped within 2 minutes in canary; still watching other regions
josh: follow-up tasks:
- instrument tls.rekey trace
- add session_rekey_count metric to console (20m retention flag)
- change billing dedupe window to 2s for streaming tokens (safety review)
- long-term: make idempotency key token-scoped rather than connection-scoped
olivia: filing a billing incident with ops to notify affected tenants and offer credits if needed
alan: also worth adding a small grace to kv-cache for 1.5s to handle transient rekeys (cheap fix)
maria: thanks everyone. once traces show the rekey events we can confirm causality and close the loop. :thumbsup:
katie: will follow up with release notes and rollback timeline in the runbook
maria: tagging this thread in the console-rollouts channel and creating a short postmortem if metrics confirm root cause
olivia: noted. I'll coordinate comms.
